sourceText: User asked: 哪需要开几个里程碑来解决吗？？？？正好验证一下B-5082的能力？？ Then approved: 那就开始吧. The agreed intent is to open a milestone-based parent story to close remaining global-lifecycle-control-plane-execution-plan.md and proof-admissibility-hardening-execution-plan.md DoD gaps while using the B-5082 ProofStory gates to prevent partial milestone completion from being declared DONE.
normalizedOutcome: The repository has a ProofStory-governed parent story that closes or explicitly classifies all seven agreed milestones for Global Control Plane and Proof Admissibility gaps, with no document DoD shrinkage hidden behind checklist completion.
acceptanceClaim: All seven milestone ledger rows are either delivered with evidence, assigned to explicit child stories through an accepted slice plan, or marked not_applicable only through an explicit user-approved scope-shrinkage decision; final ProofStory gate, intent coverage, review completeness, and DONE intent equivalence all pass.
